title: ESG Dataset Clustering & Prediction Pipeline
summary: A Streamlit-based pipeline for ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) datasets that performs unsupervised clustering (K-Means, GMM, HDBSCAN) and supervised ESG score prediction (Random Forest, LightGBM/XGBoost). Several modules directly import CTGAN, the SDV-family synthetic tabular data generator, apparently to produce synthetic ESG data alongside the modeling pipeline.
evidence: app.py:34 and prediction_sans_cls/*.py:16: 'from ctgan import CTGAN'; requirements.txt: 'sdv>=1.0.0'
needs: No call site for CTGAN() or sdv is shown beyond import statements and the requirements.txt entry; actual usage and purpose of synthetic data generation in the ESG pipeline is unverified.
